description_en: Queries the tag keys of resources within the management account or a member of your resource directory
description_zh: 查询资源目录管理账号或成员中的标签键
name: ListMultiAccountTagKeys

parameters.help_en:
The search scope. The value of this parameter can be one of the following items:

ID of a resource directory: Resources within the management account and all members of the resource directory are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html operation to obtain the ID of the resource directory. The ID is indicated by the `ResourceDirectoryId` parameter in the response of the operation.

ID of the Root folder: Resources within all members in the Root folder and the subfolders of the Root folder are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html operation to obtain the ID of the Root folder. The ID is indicated by the `RootFolderId` parameter in the response of the operation.

ID of a folder: Resources within all members in the folder are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html operation to obtain the ID of the folder. The ID is indicated by the `FolderId` parameter in the response of the operation.

ID of a member: Resources within the member are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html operation to obtain the ID of the member. The ID is indicated by the `AccountId` parameter in the response of the operation
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的账号范围。取值： 
资源目录ID，表示搜索管理账号和所有成员中的资源。资源目录ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html中的返回参数0。
Root资源夹ID，表示搜索Root资源夹及子资源夹下的所有成员中的资源。Root资源夹ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html中的返回参数1。
资源夹ID，表示搜索指定资源夹下所有成员中的资源。资源夹ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html中的返回参数2。
成员ID，表示搜索指定成员中的资源。成员ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html中的返回参数3
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If the total number of entries returned for the current request exceeds the value of the `MaxResults` parameter, the entries are truncated. In this case, you can use the `token` to initiate another request and obtain the remaining entries
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

当返回结果数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，则数据会被截断，您可以使用`NextToken`查询下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode. Valid values:

Equals: equal match

Prefix: match by prefix
parameters.help_zh:
匹配方式。取值：

Equals：相等匹配。
Prefix：前缀匹配
parameters.name: match_type

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
